headline: Sixty-three firms apply for crypto licenses with Brazil central bank by deadline
summary: A total of 63 companies, including Bitget, applied to become regulated crypto institutions with Brazil's central bank by the final submission deadline.
why: Regulatory licensing regimes for digital asset service providers bring transparency and formal compliance standards to emerging crypto markets.

impacts.name: Crypto Asset Sector
impacts.why: Formal regulatory registration integrates crypto operations into traditional financial oversight frameworks.
